scope.acceptanceRule: Inventory state is not acceptance. Every row remains fail-closed until app-specific language, product, browser, export, privacy, accessibility and SEO evidence is recorded.

stateDefinitions.native-candidate: Coverage metadata marks the Swahili owner native and no transplant, fallback, handoff or alias marker was detected. It still earns zero acceptance credit.
stateDefinitions.localized-shell-candidate: A Swahili-owned localized shell exists, but native app-level parity has not been proved. It earns zero acceptance credit.
stateDefinitions.english-fallback: The route explicitly falls back to English UI or runtime.
stateDefinitions.english-iframe: The Swahili route embeds or fetches an English app surface.
stateDefinitions.bridge-handoff: The Swahili route prepares or explains the workflow, then hands the user to another app.
stateDefinitions.alias-utility: Only an alias, noindex, redirect-like or non-self-canonical Swahili route is available.
stateDefinitions.unclassified-candidate: A mapped Swahili route exists but has no authoritative locale-coverage state.
stateDefinitions.missing: No Swahili route owner could be mapped with the accepted evidence sources.
